panels.title: Timestamp offset (execution diagnostic — not a model divergence)
panels.description: Diagnostic of the execution times only (source-2 minus source-1, in seconds). It never measures a model divergence.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "reproducibility-diff")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)

|> filter(fn: (r) => if "${model}" == "ALL" then true else r.model == "${model}")

panels.title: Divergences and missing events
panels.description: Latest divergent, missing_source_1 or missing_source_2 rows with their diagnostic fields.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "reproducibility-diff")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "reproducibility-diff")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "comparison_status" or r._field == "differing_fields" or r._field == "max_abs_diff" or r._field == "max_relative_diff" or r._field == "score_source_1" or r._field == "score_source_2")
|> filter(fn: (r) => if "${campaign_id}" == "ALL" then true else r.campaign_id == "${campaign_id}")
|> filter(fn: (r) => if "${model}" == "ALL" then true else r.model == "${model}")
|> filter(fn: (r) => if "${group}" == "ALL" then true else r.Group == "${group}")
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time", "Group", "source_event_id", "campaign_id", "model"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.comparison_status == "divergent" or r.comparison_status == "missing_source_1" or r.comparison_status == "missing_source_2")
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 50)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "Group", "source_event_id", "comparison_status", "differing_fields", "max_abs_diff", "max_relative_diff", "score_source_1", "score_source_2"])

list.definition:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
import "array"

all = array.from(rows: [{_value: "ALL"}])

values =
  schema.tagValues(
    bucket: "reproducibility-diff",
    tag: "campaign_id",
    predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "reproducibility-diff",
    start: 2020-01-01T00:00:00Z,
  )
  |> keep(columns: ["_value"])

union(tables: [all, values])
  |> group()
